title: QueueOrderViewInvalidated v1
$comment: Project-safe invalidation emitted only when the named Project lane order changed. A portfolio-only move/expiry never fans out this event to the target Project because that would disclose wider-scope activity. The payload carries no anchor, authorized Project-set hash, ordinal, action hash or free-text reason. invalidationRef.semanticHash is RFC 8785 over the complete payload excluding invalidationRef itself; envelope entityId/entityVersion equal workItemId/invalidationRef.version.

invalidationRef.description: Monotonic Project/WorkItem invalidation revision and non-circular public payload hash.
